description: This file defines an abstract base class for univariate function solvers in the Apache Commons Math library, providing common functionalities and utilities for specific solver implementations.

classes.name: BaseAbstractUnivariateSolver
classes.description: An abstract class providing default implementations and utilities for solving univariate functions with specified accuracies, including bracketing verification and evaluation counting.

methods.name: computeObjectiveValue
methods.description: Evaluates the function at a given point, counting the evaluation and checking evaluation limits.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares the solver with the function to solve and the interval parameters before execution.

methods.name: doSolve
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses; contains the logic for the root-finding algorithm.

methods.name: isBracketing
methods.description: Checks if the function values at the interval endpoints bracket a root.

methods.name: isSequence
methods.description: Checks whether three numbers form a strictly increasing sequence.

methods.name: verifyInterval
methods.description: Verifies that the interval endpoints are valid (lower < upper).

methods.name: verifySequence
methods.description: Verifies that the sequence order is valid (lower < initial < upper).

methods.name: verifyBracketing
methods.description: Verifies that the interval endpoints bracket a root and checks that the function is set.

methods.name: incrementEvaluationCount
methods.description: Increments the count of function evaluations, throwing an exception if the limit is exceeded.
